Samira H: Noting two regression reports on the v1->v2 migration page after last deploy. One is the streaming example, the other is an embeddings URL still pointing at /v1.
Owen T: Got links?
Samira H: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1778 - snippet block starting at doc/examples/migration.md#streaming.
Liam P: Paste the problematic snippet?
Samira H: ```python
# old streaming example
for chunk in client.stream_response(model_name="redwood-lite", prompt="hey"):
    print(chunk.text)
```
This breaks in the new SDK (param is `model`, callback signature changed).
Owen T: Also saw `/v1/embeddings` in the embeddings quickstart example. Should be /v2/embeddings and param rename to `model`.
Samira H: I opened a patch PR 1780 to update both snippets and add a small "Migration checklist" callout (model_name -> model, streaming callback signature, embeddings endpoint). https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1780
docs-bot: lint: examples/migration.md line 45 -> deprecated param 'model_name' detected.
Liam P: Please add a temporary compat snippet for streaming that wraps old callback signatures so internal tutorials don't break customers during the transition. Label it clearly as temporary.
Samira H: Proposed compat snippet added in PR: ```python
def stream_compat(client, *args, **kwargs):
    if 'model_name' in kwargs:
        kwargs['model'] = kwargs.pop('model_name')
    if 'on_token' in kwargs and kwargs['on_token'].__code__.co_argcount == 1:
        old_cb = kwargs['on_token']
        def new_cb(token, meta=None):
            return old_cb(token)
        kwargs['on_token'] = new_cb
    return client.stream_response(*args, **kwargs)
```
Owen T: Add a deprecation timeline note: runtime will accept model_name for 21 days with a Deprecation header. After that it returns 422. Call that out in the migration guide.
docs-bot: snippet-runner: demo tests will run on PR 1780.
Liam P: Also update the tutorial GETTING-STARTED link that references the old embeddings example. I made a quick follow-up commit in the PR.
Owen T: Running review now. One wording nit: change "compat" -> "compatibility shim (temporary)" and include security/maintenance caveats.
Samira H: Updated.
snippet-runner: All snippet tests passed against mocked endpoints.
Owen T: Merged PR 1780. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
